name: Claws That Rend, Tusks that Gore

angles.text: As a hunter, facing beasts that eluded entire generations is a true test of tracking and marksmanship. Ogtinc honors their memory by fashioning a hunter's weapon from the trophies.

faq.answer: Ogtinc is a furbolg living in Azshara who seeks to clear the former home of his people so the Blackmaw tribe can return.
The Blackmaw furbolgs cannot return to their former home while two deadly behemoths prowl the grounds.
faq.q: Why must the beasts be slain?

faq.answer: Bonesnout the Unbroken is a formidable behemoth that has survived generations of hunters attempting to fell it.
Withermaw is a massive bear roaming the former home of the Blackmaw furbolgs, unbeaten by hunters for generations.
Ogtinc intends to fashion a weapon from the claws and tusks so the strength of the fallen beasts is remembered.
faq.q: What will Ogtinc make from the trophies?

sections.body: In the rugged wilds of Azshara, two ancient behemoths patrol the grounds where the Blackmaw furbolgs once lived. Bonesnout the Unbroken and the great bear Withermaw have defeated every hunter who challenged them for generations. Now Ogtinc asks you to bring an end to their prowling so his displaced people can finally return home.
sections.title: The Lost Home

sections.body: Ogtinc takes no pleasure in ending the lives of such creatures, yet the path home remains blocked while they live. If you bring him the Claws of the Great Bear and the Tusks of the Unbroken, he promises their deaths will not be in vain. From those trophies he will carve a weapon to honor their enduring strength.
sections.title: Honoring the Fallen

summary: Ogtinc of Azshara asks you to fell two mighty behemoths, Bonesnout and Withermaw, that haunt the former home of the Blackmaw furbolgs. Removing these enduring beasts will clear the way for his people to return, and Ogtinc promises to craft a weapon from their remains to honor their strength.
attribution: In-game quest text: Claws That Rend, Tusks that Gore
